            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px">个人工具网站已经上线一段时间了，今天抽空介绍一下</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px">PS：这个工具网页已经使用一段时间了，而且目前因为工作安排原因，不怎么使用了，但是服务器都已经买了好几年了，就推广一下，应该会帮助到一些人</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px"><a href="https://zehong.tech/" rel="noopener nofollow">大泽编程杂录 (ZTechTools)</a></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202511/2115870-20251103102845918-954068383.png" alt="PixPin_2025-11-03_10-28-21" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&nbsp;1. 数据可视化工具：</span></strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px">工作中，直接从excel中复制数据，即可一键生成图标，同时可复制配置，一键跳转至echarts进行各种图表转换</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202511/2115870-20251103103314930-2166801.png" alt="PixPin_2025-11-03_10-33-09" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px">使用示例：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202511/2115870-20251103103523972-123936447.png" alt="PixPin_2025-11-03_10-35-19" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px">复制后，使用网站</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202511/2115870-20251103103639030-1489037140.png" alt="PixPin_2025-11-03_10-36-35" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202511/2115870-20251103103654134-1524834435.png" alt="PixPin_2025-11-03_10-36-52" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 16px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><strong>2.日志分析工具：</strong></p>
<p>工作中，复制一段日志， 直接根据关键词分析各个日志段的时间占用分析</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202511/2115870-20251103104903558-1934375169.png" alt="PixPin_2025-11-03_10-49-00" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;点击关键词，或者自定义关键词</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202511/2115870-20251103104926506-89737824.png" alt="PixPin_2025-11-03_10-49-23" loading="lazy"></p>
